issues: 列表高 255px 几乎顶满 270 的画面，容器上漂后首项被画框裁掉
纯黑 #0a0b10 平铺背景，条目像贴在虚空里，没有空间感
六个图标是彩虹色相渐变方块，既不是图标也没有层级
条目只有 1px 实色描边的平面，没有受光和阴影；没有当前项、快捷键等真实菜单信息
入场只有 scale + 透明度，条目和内部图标同时到位，像一张图在缩放
changes: 条目收到 26px 高、6px 间距、188px 宽，整列 ~195px，漂移全程首末项都留在安全区；DesignStage 改 raster=zoom
背景换成带靛蓝余光的暗场柔光底 + 暗角 + 细颗粒
图标换成单色线性图标（网格/文件夹/柱图/气泡/齿轮/登出），只有当前项 Dashboard 用唯一强调色；Messages 加未读 badge，其余项加 ⌘ 快捷键，Sign out 前加分隔线并降一档亮度
条目面改深石墨渐变 + 发丝线 + 顶部受光沿 + 两层软阴影
保留 0.09 stagger、0.24 行程、outBack、0.78 起始 scale 与 32px 线性漂移；入场加 1.6px→0 的对焦模糊，图标比条目晚 2f 落定形成跟随
issuesEn: The 255px list nearly filled the 270 frame, so after the upward drift the first item was clipped by the frame
Flat #0a0b10 black background with the rows floating in a void
The six icons were rainbow-hued gradient squares, neither icons nor hierarchy
Rows were flat with a 1px solid border, no lighting or shadow, and no active item, shortcuts or other real menu cues
Entrance was scale plus opacity only, with row and icon arriving together like one scaled image
changesEn: Rows shrink to 26px tall, 6px gap, 188px wide (~195px total) so first and last items stay inside the safe area through the drift; DesignStage uses raster=zoom
Background is a dark soft-lit field with a faint indigo tint, vignette and fine grain

Monochrome line icons (grid/folder/bars/bubble/gear/sign-out), with only the active Dashboard row in the single accent; Messages gets an unread badge, others get ⌘ shortcuts, and Sign out sits below a divider one step dimmer
Row surfaces use a dark graphite gradient, hairline edge, top light edge and two-layer soft shadow
Kept the 0.09 stagger, 0.24 travel, outBack, 0.78 start scale and 32px linear drift; added a 1.6px→0 focus blur on entry and icons settle 2f after their row as follow-through
